newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH COMMITTEE TAPS CONSORTIUM FOR A-2 MOTORWAY.
newsitem.headline: POLISH COMMITTEE TAPS CONSORTIUM FOR A-2 MOTORWAY.

text.p: A tender committee at the Polish transport ministry has recommended that the consortium Autostrada Wielkopolska SA be granted the concession to build and operate the planned 364-km A-2 toll motorway, PAP reported.

Late on Saturday PAP quoted the transport ministry press office as saying that Autostrada Wielkopolska's offer was the most advantageous and that the final decision would likely be made in two to three weeks.

Autostrada Wielkopolska, which includes France's Transroute SA, Germany's Strabag GmbH, Elektrim , insurers Warta and PZU SA and metals trader Impexmetal SA, is bidding against Euroroute Polska SA to build the motorway linking the city of Lodz and Swiecko on the German border.
Euroroute includes Germany's Bilfinger und Berger Bau and Spain's Dragados y Construcciones SA.
